student determined the ratio of the diameter of one cell to the diameter of a smaller cell
as 360 :85.
However, a ratio may be simplified by dividing each side by the same number to give the
smallest possible whole number on each side.
In this example, both sides of the ratio 360 :85 are divisible by 5, so the simplest ratio for
the diameters measured by the student is 72 :17.
